aspect: Data is priced against a low wage
description: Mobile data is the primary access route and is bought in small increments, which is the most expensive way to buy anything.
energy_note: Buying the internet by the handful.

aspect: And it needs electricity to be useful
description: A laptop, a router and a charged phone all depend on PWR-001. A remote job requires a power solution before it requires a skill.
energy_note: The job needs a generator before it needs you.

aspect: Which shapes what work is possible
description: Synchronous work - calls, live support, trading hours - requires reliability that cannot be promised, so the available remote work skews to asynchronous and lower-paid.
energy_note: Excluded from the jobs that need you to be reachable at two o'clock.

description: Second-round video interview, 14:00. NEPA goes at 13:40. The generator has fuel for ninety minutes and the inverter is at 22%. She joins from her phone on mobile data, in a stairwell, and apologises twice for the background noise.
energy_note: Interviewed from a stairwell, and knowing how it read.
